about: UniProt, the Universal Protein Resource. This CLI wraps the public rest.uniprot.org JSON API to search and fetch UniProtKB protein entries, sequences, publications, version history, taxonomy, keywords, diseases, UniRef clusters and proteomes, plus AlphaFold structure predictions.

commands.summary: Search UniProtKB protein entries with a query; filters such as reviewed or organism go inside the query string

params.name: query
params.description: UniProt query syntax. Free text or field queries joined with AND/OR/NOT, e.g. 'hemoglobin', '(hemoglobin) AND (reviewed:true)', '(hemoglobin) AND (model_organism:9606)', 'gene:HBB AND organism_id:9606

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated result fields. list-result-fields --database uniprotkb lists the valid names (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort as '<field> asc|desc'. Sortable fields include accession, id, gene, length, mass, organism_name, protein_name, annotation_score. Example: 'length desc'

commands.summary: Get facet counts (reviewed status, model organism, existence level, annotation score, length bins, etc.) for a UniProtKB query without fetching entries

params.name: query
params.description: UniProt query, e.g. 'hemoglobin' or '*' for everything

params.name: facets
params.description: Comma-separated facet names: reviewed, model_organism, proteins_with, existence, annotation_score, length

commands.summary: Get the full UniProtKB entry (names, genes, organism, function comments, features, cross-references, sequence) for an accession

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Optional comma-separated fields that limit the returned entry, e.g. 'accession,protein_name,cc_function,sequence' (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Download a UniProtKB entry as plain text: a FASTA sequence, the flat file, or GFF features

params.name: format
params.description: Download format: fasta (sequence), txt (UniProt flat file) or gff (features)
